title: SCAD Workshop project description
description: workshop.json at the top of an OpenSCAD project: what the project is and which files are its models, in the shape of a family manifest (family.schema.json). When a project has one, SCAD Workshop uses it instead of guessing; settings still come from the files. The app also writes one beside each project's files in its library (sources/<id>/workshop.json), and Save as project file writes one into your own projects' folders. Unknown keys are kept.

category.description: A category id, such as gridfinity, labels, wall or other; a new id makes a new category.

license.description: An SPDX id ("MIT") or { spdx, public_use, notes }.

ui.description: Per-setting changes for every model (a model's own ui wins): label, group, min, max, step, options, help…, as in a family manifest.

models.description: The project's models. Without this list, every .scad file that draws something is a model.

entrypoint.description: The model's .scad file, relative to the project's top folder.

fixed.description: Settings forced to these values and hidden from the form.

made_by.description: Which app wrote the file, and when (informational).
